Yorkshire has its own grid, for water 💧
After the 1995–96 drought disrupted supplies, Yorkshire Water built the Yorkshire Grid to move water around the county. It now reaches 99% of Yorkshire's population. Water comes from 133 reservoirs, nine river abstractions and 45 groundwater sources (around 44% reservoirs, 35% rivers, 21% boreholes), is treated at 48 works and travels through 31,000 km of mains.

Reservoir, river or borehole: where's yours from? Comment your town 👇
Source: Yorkshire Water, Water resilience in Yorkshire
